notes.title: How to add a dataset or KPI to the dashboard so both the charts and the agent see it
notes.summary: Export the array (or calculate* helper) from data/dashboard-data.ts, import it in Dashboard.tsx, add it to the useAgentContext value, render a Card with a chart whose index/categories match the row keys, and pick a colour palette

notes.title: How to add a server-side agent tool with a custom chat renderer
notes.summary: defineTool in the runtime route, add it to the BuiltInAgent tools array, mirror name + zod schema in a useRenderTool call under the provider, build a pure renderer in components/generative-ui, and add its test to the package.json test script

notes.title: How to change the agent's model, system prompt or step budget
notes.summary: Model via COPILOTKIT_MODEL env (provider/model string, default openai/gpt-5-mini) — no code change; prompt text in lib/prompt.ts; step cap maxSteps in the runtime route; a new provider prefix needs that provider's key

notes.title: One chat turn end to end — sidebar input to agent run, Tavily tool call and rendered answer
notes.summary: CopilotSidebar sends the message plus useAgentContext payloads to /api/copilotkit; the catch-all route hands it to the default BuiltInAgent (prompt, maxSteps 5); a searchInternet call runs Tavily server-side and streams back to the useRenderTool renderer; text renders through CustomAssistantMessage

notes.title: Page render — root layout, Suspense, the 1 s current-time child isolated from the Dashboard, KPIs and five chart cards
notes.summary: RootLayout (fonts, CopilotKit) → Home (Suspense with accessible fallback) → HomeContent renders CurrentTimeContext (null, ticks every second), Header, Dashboard, Footer, CopilotSidebar; Dashboard computes metrics, publishes context, registers the tool renderer and lays out cards

notes.title: Security posture — one public, unauthenticated runtime endpoint that spends LLM and Tavily credit; secrets server-only; untrusted tool output rendered defensively
notes.summary: Trust boundary is app/api/copilotkit/[[...slug]] (GET/POST, no auth, no rate limit, no middleware); env keys are read only server-side; client-supplied agent context and web-search results are untrusted and rendered without raw HTML, with an http/https link allow-list

notes.title: useAgentContext is the agent's only window onto the dashboard — two registrations, shape is the prompt
notes.summary: Dashboard.tsx publishes all five datasets plus computed metrics and page.tsx publishes the current time; anything not passed here is invisible to the agent, and the tests pin where the time context lives

notes.title: pnpm + Next 16.1.7 standalone app — exact pins that move together, a monorepo-leftover turbopack root, and a lint script whose binary is not installed
notes.summary: pnpm is the only package manager (lockfile committed, README-test enforced); next and both @copilotkit packages are exact pins; next.config turbopack.root points three levels up; oxlint is invoked but not a dependency

notes.title: One BuiltInAgent registered as "default", in-memory runner, prompt from lib/prompt.ts
notes.summary: The runtime route builds a single v2 BuiltInAgent (model from COPILOTKIT_MODEL, fallback openai/gpt-5-mini, maxSteps 5) keyed "default" on a CopilotRuntime with InMemoryAgentRunner — no service adapters, no external agent graph

notes.title: Chart index/categories props are string keys into the data rows — a mismatch renders an empty chart
notes.summary: Dashboard.tsx passes index="date"|"name"|"region"|"ageGroup" and categories like ["Sales","Profit","Expenses"] that must exactly match row keys in data/dashboard-data.ts; ChartDataItem is an index signature so TypeScript cannot catch drift

notes.title: Charts are hand-rolled Recharts wrappers with a Tremor-style API in components/ui — @tremor/react is declared but never imported
notes.summary: AreaChart, BarChart, PieChart/DonutChart share props (data, index, categories, colors, valueFormatter, show*), each redeclares ChartDataItem, uses hex palettes with fillOpacity 0.1 outlines, and must render inside a sized parent

notes.title: "use client" boundary — the only page is a client page; charts and CopilotKit consumers are client components
notes.summary: app/page.tsx is a page-level client component; every file with hooks or Recharts carries "use client"; card.tsx stays directive-free; Header/Footer carry it without needing it

notes.title: components/ layout — PascalCase app components, kebab-case ui primitives, generative-ui renderers; named exports; relative imports
notes.summary: App-level pieces (Dashboard, Header, Footer, AssistantMessage) are PascalCase files with named exports at components/; shadcn-style primitives live in components/ui (kebab-case); chat tool renderers in components/generative-ui

notes.title: CopilotKit theming works only because globals.css is imported after the v2 stylesheet and scopes vars to [data-copilotkit]
notes.summary: layout.tsx imports @copilotkit/react-core/v2/styles.css before ./globals.css; globals.css redefines --background/--primary/... under [data-copilotkit] (and its .dark forms) — reorder the imports and the overrides lose the cascade

notes.title: Every CopilotKit hook and component must render beneath the root CopilotKit provider
notes.summary: app/layout.tsx wraps all children in <CopilotKit runtimeUrl=...>; useAgentContext, useRenderTool and CopilotSidebar only work inside that subtree

notes.title: All CopilotKit imports use the /v2 subpaths at pinned 1.75.0 — never the v1 hooks or react-ui package
notes.summary: react-core/v2 (CopilotKit, CopilotSidebar, useAgentContext, useRenderTool, CopilotChatAssistantMessage, styles.css) and runtime/v2 are the only CopilotKit entry points; v1 APIs are absent and must not be reintroduced

notes.title: Tailwind v4 CSS-first theme with shadcn new-york/stone tokens in globals.css — app chrome still uses raw gray utilities
notes.summary: No tailwind.config; @import tailwindcss + @theme inline maps oklch CSS vars to utilities; cn() merges classes; card.tsx is token-based while Dashboard/Header/Footer hard-code gray-*; the .dark variant exists but nothing toggles it

notes.title: Env vars and external services — TAVILY_API_KEY and COPILOTKIT_MODEL are read in the runtime route; the LLM key is consumed inside the runtime library
notes.summary: Repo code reads exactly two env names, both server-side in the runtime route; OPENAI_API_KEY (README) is never read by repo code — the provider in @copilotkit/runtime picks it up; no NEXT_PUBLIC_ vars

notes.title: Repo agent toolbox — rafa SOP skills, harness-neutral .agents skills, the rafinery MCP server, hooks and granted permissions
notes.summary: .claude/ carries 13 rafa-* skills, 5 agent cards, the /rafa command, lifecycle hooks and three allow permissions; .agents/skills carries 7 consent-installed skills (tdd, frontend-design, vercel-composition-patterns, ...); .mcp.json registers the rafinery HTTP MCP server keyed by RAFA_MCP_KEY

notes.title: The CopilotKit runtime path is declared in three places that must agree
notes.summary: layout runtimeUrl, the handler basePath and the app/api/copilotkit/[[...slug]] folder all encode /api/copilotkit; useSingleEndpoint={false} needs the optional catch-all

notes.title: searchInternet — server tool name and parameter schema are mirrored in the client renderer
notes.summary: defineTool in the runtime route and useRenderTool in Dashboard.tsx must share the name "searchInternet" and the { query: string } schema; a mismatch silently drops the custom UI

notes.title: Three tests regex-read app/page.tsx, README.md and package.json as text — formatting and structure are asserted
notes.summary: current-time, page-accessibility and readme-runtime tests readFileSync source/docs and match regexes on function bodies, indentation, badges and code snippets; refactoring page.tsx or editing README prose can fail pnpm test

notes.title: All dashboard data is static in data/dashboard-data.ts; KPIs come from calculate* helpers with mixed return types
notes.summary: Five exported arrays plus six calculate* helpers are the entire data layer — no fetching, no DB, no API; conversion rate is a hard-coded ratio; lib/user-info.ts is dead mock code

notes.title: Tests run on node:test (+ tsx for TSX) from an explicit file list in package.json — new test files must be added to the script
notes.summary: pnpm test = node --test on three root .mjs files then tsx --test on SearchResults.test.tsx; no jest/vitest/e2e; components are tested with react-dom/server renderToStaticMarkup

notes.title: Tool renderers receive a status union and a string result — parse defensively, honour the "Error:" prefix, allow-list link schemes
notes.summary: SearchResults is the model renderer — status executing|inProgress|complete, result string|undefined parsed via zod safeParse with plain-text fallback, "Error:"-prefixed results render as errors, only http/https URLs become links

cites.token: renders a failed v2 tool result as an error

improvements.title: Public /api/copilotkit accepts anonymous POSTs that spend LLM and Tavily credit
improvements.summary: The only server route runs the agent and Tavily search with server keys for any caller - no auth, rate limit or origin check; only maxSteps bounds one turn
improvements.fix: Before any deployment beyond a local demo, wrap the handler with an auth or signed-session check plus a per-IP rate limit (or put the deployment behind platform protection); keep maxSteps as the per-turn bound

improvements.title: Dark-mode tokens and dark: classes ship but nothing ever enables dark mode
improvements.summary: globals.css defines a .dark token block and a dark custom variant, and components carry dark: classes, but no code adds the dark class and no theme library is installed
improvements.fix: Decide: wire a toggle (or prefers-color-scheme) that sets the dark class, or delete the .dark block and dark: classes

improvements.title: lib/user-info.ts is imported by nothing
improvements.summary: getUser and getUsers are leftover demo mock code with no importer; they suggest a user model the app does not have

improvements.title: Conversion Rate KPI is a hard-coded constant presented as derived data
improvements.summary: calculateConversionRate divides customers by customers*8.13, so it always shows about 12.3% - and that fabricated figure is shown as a KPI tile and fed to the agent as a metric
improvements.fix: Either add a visitors series to the dataset and compute it, or relabel the tile and agent-context field as an assumed rate (or drop it)

improvements.title: pnpm lint calls oxlint, which is not a dependency
improvements.summary: The lint script runs oxlint . but oxlint is absent from package.json and the lockfile, so pnpm lint fails on a clean clone
improvements.fix: Add oxlint as an exact-pinned devDependency (pnpm add -D oxlint), or change the script to a linter that is installed

improvements.title: next 16.1.7 carries 2 critical and 12 high advisories - bump to 16.3.3
improvements.summary: rafa audit (osv-api + pnpm audit) flags 25 advisories on the direct dep next@16.1.7, incl. 2 critical unauthenticated RCEs; all fixed by 16.3.3
improvements.fix: Bump next to 16.3.3 (exact pin, same major so the README badge test still holds); run pnpm install, pnpm test, pnpm build

improvements.title: No CI - tests, type-check and build never run on push or PR
improvements.summary: The repo has no .github workflows or other CI config; pnpm test, check-types and build only run when someone remembers to run them locally
improvements.fix: Add a minimal GitHub Actions workflow: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile, pnpm check-types, pnpm test, pnpm build

improvements.title: postcss 8.4.31 pinned by next has 2 high path-traversal advisories
improvements.summary: next@16.1.7 pins postcss@8.4.31, flagged for arbitrary file read via sourceMappingURL (2 high, 2 moderate); fixed in 8.5.23
improvements.fix: Add a pnpm override for next's postcss to >=8.5.23 (Tailwind already resolves postcss 8.5.28), run pnpm build, and re-audit

improvements.title: sharp 0.34.5 (via next) has 2 high advisories in libvips and libheif
improvements.summary: Transitive sharp@0.34.5 under next carries GHSA-f88m-g3jw-g9cj and GHSA-rgj7-g3m4-5g8c; fixed in 0.35.4
improvements.fix: After the next bump, re-run rafa audit; if sharp is still below 0.35.4 add a pnpm override sharp >=0.35.4 and re-run pnpm build

improvements.title: Accessibility test regex-matches exact indentation in app/page.tsx
improvements.summary: page-accessibility.test.mjs extracts the Suspense fallback with a regex that hard-codes six- and four-space indentation, so a formatter run breaks the test with no behaviour change
improvements.fix: Render the fallback (react-dom/server via tsx, like SearchResults.test.tsx) and assert on the markup instead of the source text

improvements.title: The test script names each test file - a new test file silently never runs
improvements.summary: pnpm test lists four files explicitly; any new *.test.* file is skipped with no error, so coverage can erode unnoticed
improvements.fix: Switch to discovery - node --test with a glob for *.test.mjs and tsx --test for *.test.tsx - so new files are picked up automatically

improvements.title: next.config turbopack.root resolves three levels above the standalone repo
improvements.summary: turbopack.root is path.resolve(__dirname, ../../..) - the old monorepo root - so Turbopack roots itself outside this repo (for a checkout on Desktop that is the user's home dir)
improvements.fix: Set turbopack.root to __dirname (or delete the turbopack block) and run pnpm dev plus pnpm build once

improvements.title: undici 5.29.0 under @copilotkit/runtime carries 3 high advisories
improvements.summary: @copilotkit/runtime > @ai-sdk/google-vertex > @ai-sdk/provider-utils@3.0.40 pulls undici@5.29.0 - 13 advisories (3 high); fixes are in undici 7.24-8.10
improvements.fix: Check whether a newer @copilotkit/runtime (bumped together with react-core) drops the provider-utils 3.x chain; otherwise add a scoped pnpm override for undici and smoke-test a chat turn

improvements.title: Seven runtime dependencies are declared but imported nowhere
improvements.summary: @tremor/react, react-hook-form, @hookform/resolvers, four @radix-ui packages, date-fns, react-day-picker and class-variance-authority are template leftovers that no file imports
improvements.fix: pnpm remove the unused packages, then pnpm check-types, pnpm test and pnpm build
